name: Kageyama Nijika
source:
Area: Fukuoka Prefecture

A university student studying engineering at a university located in big industrial area. Nijika loves robots more than men, and really likes studying and making them. She is also the member of the Mechanical Research Division... the only member, in fact. Her skills are in fact so good she got an offer from a company to help them create a large device that will be very useful for the future of mankind.
